definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 defines report as 'A printed output described in the report section and generated from those data descriptions'; 2023 drops the definition and reaches the same object through the RD and the REPORT clause (§2023:13.18.46.1). Same object in both editions, so the body groups of the report and its LINE-COUNTER are the same; scope and evidence unchanged.

pending-clause.answer: Matched on the word TERMINATE (the report writer statement, after which a pending NEXT GROUP has no effect), not on run unit termination (§2002:14.5.10), the initial state (§2002:14.5.2.1.2.1) or transfers of control (§2002:14.5.3); the rule rests on none of those clauses. pb957_next_group_forms, pb957_next_group_control and pb1001_line_next_page re-run now PASS at --std 2002 (E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/op-20261114/read-2002/out-answer/probes-a-18/witnesses-2002.txt).
